basic_details.job_title: HSHEC Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Expert, Data Analyst and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Expert/Consultant, Data Analyst, Research Expert/Consultant
basic_details.short_information: Haryana State Higher Education Council (HSHEC) has released the official Expert/ Consultant Notification 2026 on its official website, https://hshec.gov.in/. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced under the HSHEC Expert/Consultant Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with a Ph.D. or Master's Degree in relevant fields along with significant post-qualification experience can apply. The age limit will be as specified in the official notification. Candidates can submit their applications through Email on or before 03 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application details are avail

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. or Master's Degree in relevant fields with significant post-qualification experience.
qualification.details: Senior Expert/Consultant: Ph.D. with at least 15 years' post-qualification experience in the relevant fields of Administration/Academics/Research with a background in managing and overseeing research projects OR execution of Research work/project OR managing/supervising experience in Major/minor research projects of UGC. Data Analyst: Master's Degree / M. Tech. in Computer Science Engineering/ Information Systems/Technology with at least 60% from a recognized university. Seven years post-qualification experience in data analysis, management & work related to data driven insights, report writing, with experience in designing survey questionnaire module, Computer applications or Apps / website etc. Research Expert/Consultant: Ph.D. OR Master Degree in Humanities/Science/ Commerce/ Technology with, at least 60% marks from recognised university. At least 5 years' post-qualification experience in the relevant fields of Administration/Academics/Research with a background in managing and overseeing research projects OR execution of Research work/project.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for HSHEC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HSHEC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HSHEC Expert/Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Expert/Consultant positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Expert/Consultant positions, including Senior Expert/Consultant, Data Analyst, and Research Expert/Consultant roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: For the Data Analyst position, a Master's Degree / M. Tech. in Computer Science Engineering/ Information Systems/Technology with at least 60% from a recognized university is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the Research Expert/Consultant position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Expert/Consultant position ranges from Rs. 90,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000/- per month, and it is negotiable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. You need to send your application to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the HSHEC Expert/Consultant roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on academic/professional qualifications, experience, and an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category of candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the experience required for the Senior Expert/Consultant post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 15 years of post-qualification experience in relevant fields like Administration, Academics, or Research is required for the Senior Expert/Consultant position.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the hardcopy of my application?
faq.answer: The hardcopy of your application should be sent via courier/registered post to State Project Director, Haryana State Higher Education Council, Takniki Shiksha Sadan, Bays no. 7-12 Sector-4 Panchkula.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Expert/Consultant positions is on a Contract basis.
